spatial_resources.description: Study of immunosuppressive macrophages in papillary RCC. The 2025 full paper describes a CosMx 960-target RNA assay on tissue from 11 mixed-RCC patients, with four papillary and 24 clear-cell cores across three orthogonal sections; its 16 papillary and 70 clear-cell RCC patients are multiplex-IF cohorts, not spatial RNA counts. A public Seurat object (Harvard Dataverse OUWYBU, CC BY 4.0; also on Zenodo 12730227) holds 199,112 cells and three slide identifiers but no patient, histology or treatment crosswalk, and the broader deposit spans several treatment groups. Both repositories direct clinical enquiries to Brandon Manley, and the public code refers to an unreleased clinical table.
